title: Jazzy Smoky Uruguayan uni Sushi
description: A cultured, springy and keto-friendly Uruguayan sushi that showcases fresh uni with a smoky twist. Perfect for showing off at dinner parties.
instructions: Rinse the nori sheets and pat them dry with a clean towel.
In a small bowl mix the cauliflower rice with the smoked paprika, smoked sea salt, and a splash of sesame oil.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and add the seasoned cauliflower rice, letting it toast for 5 minutes until fragrant.
Gently fold in the diced avocado, julienned cucumber, and grated ginger, cooking for an additional 2 minutes.
Meanwhile, place the nori halves on a flat surface and spread a thin layer of the toasted cauliflower mixture across each sheet.
Top each nori sheet with generous spoonfuls of fresh uni, drizzle with lemon juice, and sprinkle toasted sesame seeds.
Fold the sides of the nori over the filling, then roll tightly to form a sushi roll.
Slice each roll into 6 equal pieces and arrange them on a plate.
Garnish the sushi with lime zest and a light drizzle of soy sauce for umami.
Serve immediately and enjoy the smoky, crusty bite of authentic Uruguayan sushi.
